description: Main Dart source file for a Flutter frontend application implementing filtered match searches with Ocean Professional theme styling, filter controls including dropdowns and chips, state management, and network fetch logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting application theme and initializing repository.

classes.name: CanonicalOption
classes.description: Represents filter option with display label and query key.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: DTO for user-selected filters, capable of converting to URL query parameters.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enum representing hair color options for filtering.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Stateful widget providing filter UI, applying filters, and displaying results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; loads environment variables and runs the app.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Defines a custom Ocean Professional color scheme based on brightness.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Constructs a ThemeData object with custom color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp and provides repository to the filters page.

methods.name: toQueryParams
methods.description: Builds URL query parameters from filter preferences.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of FilterPreferences with optional modifications.

methods.name: _applyFilters
methods.description: Triggers filter fetch, manages loading/error state, and updates results.

methods.name: _buildDropdownItems
methods.description: Creates dropdown menu items with 'Not specified' option.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the FiltersPage widget UI, including filter controls and results display.
